summary: Verified 6.5/10 (reviewer 6.5, previous 6.0). NOT ON PAR: under 7.5. No confirmed blocker. I checked the reviewer's fresh captures, which postdate the shipped GLBs (shots Nov 7 15:08; sukri*.glb Nov 6 19:51). The cards date from Nov 4 and have not changed since. I re-read the measurement reports and the lineup JSON. All three majors stand. (1) At the game camera the hood is a smooth cream egg (closing_sukri_r2_match_game_x4.png). The cup is a tiny prop at the edge. Lineup accentPct is 0.00-0.02 per facing and accentOk is False, against a brief of about 0.2%. (2) The cards are posterized Cycles renders on a painted plate. The base splash puts a fist and the cup at the chin. Neither skin splash shows the staging its brief names. (3) On the Shadeprint card, a pale disc (#C8BFB0, sat 0.26 measured) with orange slits sits over white bars on ink, which reads as a skeleton costume. On the 3D model (three_sukri_shadeprint.png) the bars read more as diagonal wrap stripes. It stays a major, not a blocker. The face has a smile and nose, and its eye inlays are lit and warm, which is exactly the fix owner ruling 2 accepted for Odrum's grey mask. One part of the violet-cup point is softened: sukri.md gives the dawnglass as clear, with the violet coming from VFX plus a painted ring. The thin violet ring is to spec, but the deluxe signature still does not show at rest. Missed sensitivity: none. The hood is a rounded, elongated dome at all 8 facings and in the side close-up (closing_sukri_r2_sheet.png), not pointed or conical. The base and Stillwater faces read as kindly. Timing not measured (load 11-89).

findings.title: At the game camera Sukri reads as a plain cream egg; the cup hook barely registers
findings.what: From the gameplay camera the hood is one smooth cream dome with no seam, hem or weave. The face disc is hidden from behind and above, and the cup is a few pixels at the silhouette edge.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_sukri_r2_match_game_x4.png (viewed: white dome, cup at the far left); closing_sukri_r2_sheet.png row 1 facings 3-7; _harness/_reports/closing_sukri_r2_hood_lstar.txt (p50 70.6, p90 87.3); art/renders/lineup/fw_CW6_m_lineup.json accentPctMax 0.02, accentOk False
findings.gauge: LoL gauge: a champion's top surface carries designed breaks, and a signature prop reads in a 1-second glance from above. VALE now: one flat dome, and the hook is sub-read.
findings.fix: As the reviewer proposes: a seam ridge, a darker rolled hem, gathered nape folds and a cream-to-warm gradient. Raise the cup and the bead's emissive so the accent is at least 0.2% from every facing.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced from the cited shots and lineup JSON. The hood back does show 2-3 soft folds (sheet crop 8), but they vanish at the game camera. Major, not blocker.

findings.title: Splash and portraits are filtered 3D renders, and the skin splashes miss their staged moments
findings.what: All cards are posterized Cycles renders on a painted plate. The base splash has a fist and the cup at the chin, covering the mouth. The Stillwater and Shadeprint splashes are near-neutral stands with the cup hanging from the crook. sukri.md:185 asks for the breath on the cup and the tipped wind-up.
findings.gauge: LoL gauge: painted illustrations with a kit-telling pose, integrated light, and a distinct composition per skin. VALE now: filtered renders with idle stances.
findings.fix: Repose per sukri.md:185 and paint over (roster-wide card major).
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed by viewing the three splashes. This is roster-wide card pipeline debt; the staging miss is specific to Sukri.

findings.title: Shadeprint: white rib-like bars under a pale disc, and the violet cup light does not read at rest
findings.what: On the card, white bars on ink under a pale low-saturation face disc with orange slits read as a skeleton costume. The violet shows only as a thin ring under the azure bead.
findings.gauge: LoL gauge: a deluxe skin's theme and its changed signature element read clearly at the game camera. VALE now: an off-tone skeleton read on the cards, and no visible violet in play.
findings.fix: Print continuous rims along each wrap band's upper edge, not floating bars. Warm the face disc toward toned wood, the same route owner ruling 2 took for Odrum. Add a violet inner glaze to the glass.
findings.verifierNote: Not escalated. The smile, nose and lit warm inlays meet ruling 2's 'alive face' standard, and on the model the bars read as diagonal wrap stripes. The 'invisible violet' sub-claim is partly by design: sukri.md:174 gives the dawnglass as clear, with the violet coming from VFX plus a painted ring (sukri.md:89). The ring exists but is thin, so it is still a valid deluxe-signature gap.

findings.title: attack2 and Mote Toss share nearly the same staff arc
findings.what: Clip sheet rows 2 and 3 show the same back-left staff swing.
findings.gauge: LoL: each attack and spell is distinct by silhouette.
findings.fix: Make Mote Toss a crouch-and-rise underhand lob.

findings.title: Run carries the crook across the face disc
findings.what: The staff crosses in front of the face throughout the run loop.
findings.gauge: LoL: the face and signature prop stay clear in the run.
findings.fix: Carry the staff lower, across the hips.

findings.title: Hands are stiff mitten fists and claws
findings.what: A blocky fist, and an 'open' hand that curls into a claw in the skin splashes.
findings.gauge: LoL: hands carry gesture in close-ups.

findings.title: Death keeps the cup on the hook and ends in a hood ball
findings.what: The cup stays with the grounded staff, and the end pose is a hood-covered lump.
findings.gauge: LoL: deaths end on a legible pose with the prop placed.
findings.fix: Unhook the cup and let it roll to rest upright.
